title: Directive Composition API
description: Learn how the directive composition API lets you compose behaviors directly onto component host elements in Angular.

blocks.text: Angular's Directive Composition API allows you to apply directives to component host elements directly from within the TypeScript component decorator. This enables powerful code reuse without classical class inheritance.
